latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Slack CLI skill for macOS.
- Read, send, search, and manage Slack messages and DMs directly via the slk CLI.
- Supports Slack channel and DM reading, sending messages, searching, checking unreads, managing drafts, saved items, and viewing threads.
- Session-based authentication: auto-extracts user session from Slack desktop app using macOS Keychain (no tokens or OAuth required).
- Designed for personal agent workflows and heartbeat checks with extensive command options.
- macOS only; acts with user's permissions and session.
